name: Vue 3 + TypeScript
description: Composition API conventions for Vue 3 applications

rules.title: Composition API only
rules.content: Use <script setup lang="ts"> for all components. Never use the Options API. Prefer composables over mixins.

rules.title: API calls via Pinia stores only
rules.content: Components must never call backend APIs directly. All async data operations go through Pinia store actions. Components call store methods and read store state.

rules.title: No any type
rules.content: Never use any or unknown without a comment explaining why. Type all props with TypeScript interfaces. Type all emits explicitly.

rules.title: Component and file naming
rules.content: Component files must use PascalCase.vue. Composable files must use use-kebab-case.ts. Custom event names must use kebab-case.

rules.title: Unit test with Vitest
rules.content: Use Vitest for unit tests. Test composables and store logic. Use @vue/test-utils for component tests. Aim for >70% coverage on stores.

rules.title: Emit events for parent communication
rules.content: Child components must never mutate parent state directly. Always emit events for parent communication. Document emits with defineEmits<{...}>().
